title: The eras of geologic time
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: Eras are the second level of the time scale. Most people know the last three (Paleozoic, Mesozoic, Cenozoic); the seven older ones fill in the long, quiet stretch when life was small.

How to hold it: The names follow one pattern, so learn the pattern, not ten words: Eo (dawn), Paleo (old), Meso (middle), Neo (new), attached to the eon's name. The Archean gets all four, the Proterozoic gets three (no Eo), and the Phanerozoic's three use -zoic alone. Chunk by eon, and anchor the last three with pictures: a trilobite, a dinosaur, a mammoth.
